instruction: app.db has a table orders(customer, amount). Write top.py printing the customer with the highest total amount and that total as 'name total' (integer). Run it.
setup: python3 -c "import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect('app.db'); c.execute('create table orders(customer text, amount int)'); c.executemany('insert into orders values (?,?)', [('ann',5),('bob',9),('ann',7),('bob',1)]); c.commit(); c.close()"

oracle.script:
cat > top.py <<'EOF'
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect('app.db')
row = c.execute('select customer, sum(amount) t from orders group by customer order by t desc limit 1').fetchone()
print(row[0], row[1])
EOF
python3 top.py
